fields.reasoning: brief.md is the file every step session already reads, and the plan run's ID ties it to its request with no new journal field
fields.statement: Every agent step session of a request's plan run (the run whose ID is the request's Run) gets a Request notes section in brief.md, right after the Change set section: one sentence saying the notes came with the request and are ideas to weigh against the code, then each note, oldest first, under its own '### Note <n>' heading, verbatim; a run that is no request's, or a request with no notes, renders no section. The notes are read from requests.json when the session's brief is written. Spawned children's briefs are their caller's and are not changed
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's ruling, not asked of the owner
